title: Network Outage Response
description: Network failures affecting operational monitoring and utility infrastructure
triggers: Complete network outage affecting grid monitoring
Wide-area network issues affecting utility operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on grid monitoring and operational control
Activate emergency network bypass if available
investigation_steps: Check network device status and logs
Verify ISP connectivity and circuit status
Analyze network traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart failed network devices following standard procedures
Implement redundant network paths if available
Coordinate with ISP for circuit issues
Apply network configuration fixes or rollbacks
verification: Test connectivity to grid monitoring systems
Test remote access for operational staff
special_considerations: Never directly modify operational control systems without customer authorization
Operational technology incidents require NOC escalation
Grid monitoring is critical for utility operations
